verdict.rationale: Apify documents exporting scraped datasets into portable formats (CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML), which covers the data half of the story. Job configurations are persisted as tasks on the platform, but no evidence shows they can be exported in a portable format for migration. missing for 10: documented export of task/Actor/schedule configurations, explicit migration-out or anti-lock-in guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my scraped data and job configurations in a portable format to migrate to another provider without lock-in

citations.quote: This merged dataset can then be exported into various formats such as CSV, JSON, XLSX, or XML.
Multiple input schemas for one Actor can be persisted in tasks.
